svg.title: Interview briefing: architecture
svg.desc: A visitor uses the Streamlit UI on Render, which calls the FastAPI service on Render with a shared token. The API runs the LangGraph pipeline (Researcher, Editor, human review pause, Writer) and the quick check, using Claude and Tavily, with run checkpoints and daily usage counts in Neon Postgres. An offline eval harness replays the pipeline with an independent judge.
svg.text: Architecture as deployed: two free Render services in Ohio, a Neon Postgres database, and an offline eval harness
Every API call carries the shared
time; won't start on Render without it
No public API docs once deployed
Shared typed state, checkpointed after every step
verified · unverified · contradicted · from posting · off-target
score below 7, passes left: back to research
you send it back with a note (1 in low-cost mode)
Static page, no JavaScript, strict content security policy
Demo video, how it works, and the measured eval results
"Try the demo" opens the Streamlit UI
Run checkpoints: a run paused for
Today's usage counts, so a restart
One Tavily search on visa data sites,
one Claude call on H-1B history
A "yes" must quote a result word for word,
or it becomes "couldn't determine": in code
Replays the pipeline on fixed companies and job postings
Independent judge: claude-opus-5 with its own fresh searches
Results published as measured, with their limits
Limits and caps as set in api.py, graph.py and render.yaml
